items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Piano player. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He was a hell of a piano player. He could have made it as a pianist, you know.

ctx.x: Roses of Picardy. And he sang it beautifully. I thought he had the job, you know, could sing then. But he was too shy to sing, you know? He never even thought of it. As I'd say, he'd bit his fingernails off, trying to get new thoughts, you know. I mean, he would bite them off into the quick, down to the cuticle almost, you know? Where his fingers -- the ends of them would turn up on the ends, where he had no fingernails.
Yeah. He was a hell of a piano player. He could have made it as a pianist, you know.
